exposure: Hospitalization in neonatal intensive care unit
outcome: Intestinal carriage of multidrug-resistant Gram-negative bacteria
cohort: 34 preterm infants admitted to the neonatal intensive care unit in a tertiary teaching hospital in Malaysia.
finding: High prevalence rates of intestinal carriage of multidrug-resistant K. pneumoniae and E. coli were found in hospitalized preterm infants, particularly high resistance to polymyxins.
mod_finding: Delivery mode was found to be a predictor of polymyxin B resistance.
